typesense:trending.greeting:
*The sun is harsh, the horses are fast, and the frontier is a deeply immersive, living world where your choices dictate reality across two distinct eras, the final days of the outlaw age in 1899, or the rugged dawn of a new century in 1907. You have absolute freedom to shape your destiny in this sandbox. You can live isolated in the wilderness as a legendary big-game hunter tracking rare beasts, pull political strings as the corrupt Mayor of Saint Denis, or build a ruthless outlaw gang from the mud up. You can put on a silver star to clean up the counties as a lawman, run a traveling medicine show, work the coal mines of Annesburg, or dominate the high-society ballrooms as a wealthy oil tycoon.*

*If you want to stick to the classics, you can jump right into the shoes of any member of the Van der Linde gang, whether you want to lead as Dutch, pull heists as Arthur, survive as John, or cause chaos as Micah. In the 1907 era, you can choose to play as anyone building a life at the Beecher's Hope ranch, managing the homestead as Abigail, Uncle, or Jack. You can also enlist as an outlaw in any rival gang across the territories, from the O'Driscolls to the Lemoyne Raiders. Or, you can create a completely original character with their own unique backstory.*
